purpose: Personal Life Operating System (PLOS) that treats human life as a stateful, evolving system. Unifies identity development, execution, reflection, AI assistance, and long-term progression into one coherent platform.
target_users: Phase 1: Founders, executives, operators managing complex multi-domain lives
Phase 1: High-agency individuals already doing the work but lacking system coherence
Phase 2+: Coaches, consultants, business owners, leadership teams, creative professionals
product_promise: The world's first comprehensive Personal Life Operating System that turns life into a unified, coherent operating system where every input flows into a synchronized backend and powers every module.
vision_statement: To create a personal operating system that unifies identity development, execution, reflection, AI assistance, and long-term progression into a single coherent system with visible progression, measurable momentum, and real consequence.
modules: Dashboard (Daily command center with Stats HUD)
Missions System (7 categories with scope calibration)
NOVA AI System (6 roles: Advisor, Coach, EA, Operator, Workflow Engine, Admin Agent)
Chronilog (7 subsystems: Logs, Reflections, Feedback, Rituals, Timeline, Mission Logs, Rolodex)
Systems Page (9 modules: Calendar, Boards, Canvas, Knowledge Graph, Spreadsheets, Docs, Forms, Templates, Media Library)
Onboarding: The Awakening Protocol (9 missions, 100+ questions)
Gamification (XP, Levels, Streaks, Efficiency, Stats HUD)

workflows: Complete daily onboarding (Awakening Protocol) seeding all modules
Daily dashboard check — review Stats HUD, active missions, logs
Create and execute missions across 7 categories
Log data entries, energy levels, reflections, intentions
Interact with NOVA AI for coaching, planning, execution
Review Chronilog for historical patterns and timeline
Track XP, level progression, and streak maintenance
feature_list: Stats HUD with 8 meters (Level/XP, Streak, Efficiency, Attention, Time, Energy, Health, Wealth)
7 log types (Data Entry, Energy, Reflection, Intention Setter, Mission Log, Stats Log, System Log)
7 mission categories (Daily/Ritual, Skill, Project, Belief/Trait/Behavior, Shadow/Instinct, Reflection, System Calibration)
Mission failure handling (auto-rollover, resize, AI dialogue)
XP system with tiered level thresholds
Cross-view architecture (Calendar, Boards, Canvas, Knowledge Graph, etc.)
ai_agent_concepts: NOVA (Neural Operating Virtual Assistant) — multi-role AI system operator
6 NOVA roles: Advisor, Coach, Executive Assistant, Operator, Workflow Engine, Admin Agent
Tone: neutral, calm, systemic — NO emojis, NO praise, NO hype
Phase 3: multi-agent orchestration with 5 agent types (Research, Scheduling, Content, Analysis, Integration)
Governance: capability-based permissions, approval tiers, audit logs, emergency stop, rollback
umh_integration_assumptions: LyfeOS is part of broader Lyfe Institute ecosystem alongside EOS and CreatorOS
Tabs 52-53 describe 3-layer Human Operating System Ecosystem with shared Platform Kernel
Shared kernel: Identity, AI Runtime, Workflow Engine, Event Bus, Memory Graph, Integration Layer, Notification System, UI Design System
CURRENT isolated MVP at lyfeos.net is standalone with NO UMH/substrate connection
Future UMH integration would map NOVA to substrate model_router/agent architecture
UMH integration is aspirational — no implementation contracts exist

auth_assumptions.end_state: Global identity shared across LyfeOS/EOS/CreatorOS, enterprise SSO (SAML, OAuth) Phase 4

gamification_mechanics.streaks: Consecutive days with >=1 mission completed. Resets to 0 if missed. Focus on momentum, not perfection.

archetypes.outputs: Dominant, Secondary, Shadow archetypes. Combo Profile if top 2 within 3 points

gamification_mechanics.anti_patterns: Explicitly NO badges, confetti, praise language

open_questions: File storage: Cloudflare R2 or Backblaze?
Cross-platform kernel: conceptual only — no implementation plan
Event bus contracts: no schema or protocol defined
Billing model: individual vs ecosystem subscription?
contradictions: PRD v1.0 (4 tabs, 3 models) vs v2.0 (5 tabs, 5 models) coexist in same document
Timeline: 6-8 weeks vs Months 0-2 vs Months 0-4 vs 10-12 weeks
Document claims 'complete and ready for implementation' multiple times for different versions
Mission states: schema shows active/completed/deleted but PRD mentions in-progress
Tab 8 repeats large sections of Tab 1 in slightly different formats
Competitive analysis headers exist but content is empty

isolated_mvp.description: Standalone app with NO UMH/substrate connection

umh_connected_mvp.description: LyfeOS integrated with UMH substrate (NOVA→model_router, shared kernel)
umh_connected_mvp.blocked_by: UMH integration boundary undefined, no implementation contracts

acceptance_criteria_candidates: User can complete Awakening Protocol onboarding (9 missions, 100+ questions)
User can view Stats HUD with 8 live meters on dashboard
User can create and complete missions across 7 categories
User can log data entries, energy, reflections, and intentions
User can interact with NOVA AI for coaching and task execution
User can view Chronilog historical timeline
User can view and edit Player Profile / Character Sheet
User can see XP, level, and streak progression
User can discover archetype through calibration quiz
End-state: multi-agent NOVA orchestration with 5 agent types

End-state: Systems page with 9 cross-view modules

prd_quality.strengths: Every hex color code, every XP formula, every SQL schema specified. Most detailed PRD. Isolated MVP proves executability.
prd_quality.weaknesses: v1/v2 version conflicts, timeline inconsistencies, massive repetition across tabs, missing error handling/offline/operational specs
